name: Jumbo Interactive Limited
summary: Jumbo Interactive Limited engages in the retail of lottery tickets through the internet and mobile devices in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Fiji, and internationally. It operates through Lottery Retailing, Software-as-a-Service, Managed Services, and Dream Giveaways segments. The company is involved in the retail of digital lottery tickets through Oz Lotteries; and lottery management services, including prize procurement, lottery game design, campaign marketing, and customer relationship and draw management services to businesses and charities.
